I eakspa Igpa Atinla and I also spogeak hog logatin (translation: I speak pig latin and I also speak hog latin), but don't ask me what Monkshe Ad Hammerhead means cuz homies don't speak or really understand no latin! Maybe there's been some monks added to the Hammerhead such that this clone is more holy than the original registered cultivar? Whatever the truth may be, I don't think a fancier name could have been given to this clone, so as you read this description, imagine MW in a suit and tie just for added effect.

From what I've been told, this is essentially another clone of the famous hummer's hammerhead: it's either from the same cross (ie. a sibling), a selfing of the original clone, or some genotype related to Hummer's Hammerhead but it ain't the same clone as this baby:


What's the difference? Sorry Brah (or Guuurrl, depending on your gender), I haven't had this thing long enough to tell, but I think the lid thingi ma bobber is longer on this one when it reaches vegetative maturity. That's the scientific explanation, as far as I know. The yellow coloration is absolutely stunning!

This thing was a son of a BEAST to take pictures of, and this was the best I could do. S. Monkshe Ad Hammerhead, pics tkaen 7/1/21. Fall traps will be much more impressive, so stay tuned:
